args.subject: Group stay availability inquiry – 10 people in June
args.body:
Hello City Hub Tokyo team,

I'm organising a group stay for 10 people and would like to ask about your availability in June. Could you let me know which dates you can accommodate our group, along with room options, group rates, and any booking requirements?

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
